name: 親課題を示すカード行
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Generate ONE Lighthouse component LH09-0009 親課題を示すカード行, a compact task-parent breadcrumb.
Hierarchy: ORIGINAL images1(crop) and2(fullscreen) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, opticalstroke, alignment, spacing and fine details. The crop cuts part of the assignee; resolve it from image2's top card in Done column. Japanese mock image3 is SECONDARY content/layout; don't reproduce its rough substitute glyphs. Image4 is official white/materialstyle only, no buscontent.
One quiet horizontal row, approx310x30 logicalpixels. Exact Japanese: metadata「作業-20」then original tiny thin right-pointing chevron, then parentname「利用者への聞き取り」. Atfar right original tiny assignee/person inside fine dotted circularperimeter, wholly visible, notcropped. Match original icon proportions/strokes andbaselinealignment. Short Japanese parentname fits in one line; no invented ellipsis or additional title.
Meiryo Regular12/16 for this metadata row, zerotracking, normalweight. Muted text #6E6E6E, supporting glyphs #526173. Pure white #FFFFFF rowandcanvas, no broadgraystrip, cardwrapper, fillbutton, greenaccent or decorative gradients: there is no selectedstate or primaryfilledaction. No addedcontrols, rows or metrics. Compact grouping andtight framing withminimalouterpadding. Staticcandidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画像全体と切抜き、通常/390幅モックを実見。切抜きの右側担当者不足は全画面参照で補完。作業20/利用者への聞き取り、細い右矢印と全体が見える点線担当者を確認。中立メタ情報のため色を増やさず白・スレートへ統一。外周余白あり。原ベクターと書体同一性、クリック実動作は未証明。候補のエージェント目視確認であり所有者承認・新ネイティブ・アプリ実装とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
